notes: Eye openness is the normalized original open-to-closed geometry blend, not a measured iris area.
Only aperture and native lash paths deform; iris, glasses, hair and eye-refined gradients stay intact.
ExpressionRig coordinates its mouth preset with external speech through setSpeaking().

mouth_refinements.speech_poses: See E9 upper_arc_refinements, speech_refinements and reference_shapes

speech_refinements.teeth_attachment: Whole reference path shifted above aperture; see reference_shapes

upper_arc_refinements.method: reference arch at natural proportions, then continuous Y adaptation to preserve aperture bounds

reference_shapes.method: whole-path axis scaling and translation only; no control-point reshaping

glasses_fix.scope: Fixed full-time upper right rim, independent of eye aperture and expression fading.

inherited_left.left_fringe: source2426 root connected to source2424 lower contour
inherited_left.right_fringe: complete fixed fringe in every expression
inherited_left.hair_changes: left smile/wink connection; right complete contour and seam in all expressions

right_hair.restored_contour_source: native 2615 upper contour with accepted E2 pointed endpoint

dynamic_lash_changes.fragment: upper contour shared with 2615 / 2551; iris body excluded

right_hair.scope: complete right fringe in all expressions; E3 left fixes preserved

corner.scope: smile/wink only; neutral/sleepy/fallback retain prior corner art
